fields.session: first eight characters of the pilot's session id
fields.mode: subagent (no name, one report) | teammate (named, mailbox) | fork
fields.name: teammate name, null for an unnamed subagent
fields.agent_type: subagent_type passed to the Agent tool
fields.model: model named in the spawn; null if not recorded
fields.purpose: one line: what the crew member was sent to do
fields.access: read and write scope granted in the brief
fields.delivery: how the result came back and to whom
fields.verified: the pilot's check of the report: what held, what was wrong
fields.cost: tokens, tool uses or duration when the harness reported them; null otherwise
